definitions.explanation: interrogative asking about the number of times or frequency of an action

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}{言|い}ったら{分|わ}かるの？
examples.english: How many times do I have to tell you?

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}は{何度|なんど}{見|み}ても{飽|あ}きない。
examples.english: No matter how many times I watch this movie, I never get tired of it.

examples.japanese: {何度|なんど}も{失敗|しっぱい}したが、{諦|あきら}めずに{挑戦|ちょうせん}し{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: I failed many times, but I kept challenging myself without giving up.

notes:
RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
- {何度|なんど}も (many times)
- {何度|なんど}でも (any number of times)
- {何度|なんど}か (several times)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{何回|なんかい} is largely interchangeable with {何度|なんど}, though {何度|なんど} often emphasizes the emotional weight or significance of repetition, while {何回|なんかい} is more neutral and countable.

USAGE NOTE:
{何度|なんど} can also mean "how many degrees" when referring to temperature or angles, though this is less common in everyday conversation.
